title: The Last Plunger
episode_goal: Maya must rescue the eleven hidden workers, stop Adrian's analog demolition, and secure enough evidence to clear her name.
synopsis: Maya frees eleven concealed workers and secures their duplicate orders before Adrian traps them with his analog demolition plunger; she severs the trunk line, records his coercion, and delivers the witnesses and physical evidence that clear her name, charge Adrian, and trigger inspections of every Vale tower.

character_states.name: Maya Chen
character_states.motivation: Clear her name by proving developer fraud without putting residents or workers at risk.

character_states.name: Adrian Vale
character_states.motivation: Destroy Vale Meridian and the records linking him to its counterfeit components.

character_states.name: Luis Ortega
character_states.motivation: Evacuate everyone safely while preserving admissible evidence against Adrian.

character_states.name: Elena Ruiz
character_states.motivation: Save her crew and reveal the work orders Adrian forced her to follow.

character_states.name: Inspector Shaw
character_states.motivation: Establish the truth through physical records, testimony, and forensic evidence.

final_scene_outcome: Maya is cleared, Adrian is charged, Meridian's residents are protected, and his remaining towers face inspection.
final_turning_point: Maya uses her restored authority to demand protection for residents before beginning the wider audit.
next_episode_question: How many other Vale towers will Maya's citywide audit expose?
